text.title: Google Ads Campaign Setup Examples
text.summary: Reference tables the rules assume: campaign type selection by goal and the RSA asset specification.

section.title: Campaign type selection

list.item: SEARCH: people actively searching — best for high-intent leads, simplest to optimize
DISPLAY: image ads across websites — brand awareness, retargeting
SHOPPING: product feed-driven — e-commerce with Merchant Center feed
VIDEO: YouTube ads — views, awareness, product demos

section.note: New advertisers start with SEARCH (default-to-search rule); PERFORMANCE_MAX is gated on conversion volume, not preference.

section.title: Responsive Search Ad specification

list.item: Include: keyword, benefit, social proof, CTA, offer/urgency

section.note: The launch gate rejects an RSA under 15 headlines or 4 descriptions (rsa-15-headlines-required rule); the ad-copy template in `templates/ad-copy.md` is laid out to these limits.
